nodes.label: Rental agreement template rich-text editor
{{variable}} placeholder insertion from the template-variable registry
BoldSign e-sign field tags ({{@sig1}}, {{@date1}}, {{@init1}}) become interactive signing areas
Only setContent when HTML actually differs, to avoid cursor jumping on external template load
Bring-your-own Twilio SMS connection (tenant owns account, number and bill)
Inbound-SMS and status-callback webhooks auto-configured on the tenant's Twilio number
Four-step in-product Twilio account setup guide (~10 minutes)
Gotcha: Twilio trial accounts can only SMS verified caller IDs, so the test send fails until the tenant verifies their own mobile
Gotcha: US/Canada SMS needs one-time 10DLC brand and campaign registration (1-7 days carrier review)
Auth Token treated as a password: stored encrypted and never echoed back to the browser
Twilio WhatsApp sender configuration on the tenant row
WhatsApp is gated on Twilio SMS being connected first — both ride the same Twilio account
Meta message-template lifecycle: create, poll approval status, delete
Decision: one approved 'general' conversation-opener template also unlocks lockbox-code delivery (hasApprovedLockboxTemplate = hasGeneralTemplate)
Inbound WhatsApp webhook must be pasted into the Twilio console by hand (one-time, per number)
Template authoring guidelines to avoid Meta rejection (transactional only, no URLs, unique names, no edge variables)
Tenant billing surface: metered usage plus subscription invoice history
Platform subscription invoice history with Base/Usage/Total split, pay and download actions
Per-category metered usage view — e-sign agreements at $1.00 each
Base/Usage columns shown only when some invoice in the list carries a breakdown, decided list-wide so columns never flicker on 'Show all'
Read usage_amount alone — gating on base_amount hid a fully-metered invoice because the webhook stores base 0 which `baseAmount || null` writes as NULL
Wording states what was RECORDED, never what was billed — local metering and Stripe reporting are separate steps that fail independently
Month labels built from split parts, not new Date('2026-03'), which UTC-parses to the previous month west of Greenwich
Invoice PDF falls back to the hosted invoice page, and to a disabled control when a webhook never landed (never a dead link)
WhatsApp Business onboarding via Meta Embedded Signup (Facebook JS SDK, WABA + phone_number_id + auth code)
WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP session info read from postMessage with a facebook.com origin check
500ms setTimeout workaround so the FB.login callback sees the sessionInfo the message listener may not have delivered yet
Portal developer tool belt (floating panel, Ctrl+Shift+D)
Panel renders only under NODE_ENV==='development' so no test affordance ships to production
Seeds customers, vehicles, fines and payments straight into Supabase with the current tenant_id, bypassing the real forms
CustomEvent bridge (DEV_FILL_*_FORM_EVENT) fills the target page's form after router.push plus a 1s settle delay
Predicate-based React Query invalidation so tenant-scoped key variants are all matched
Seeded payment is inserted then applied through apply-payment (FIFO), mirroring the production money path
Call-forwarding experience test: TwiML preview vs a real billed call
Preview renders the exact TwiML with no ring or charge; Test call places a REAL billed call on the tenant's own Twilio account (explicit confirm)
Business-line caller ID plus whisper name announcement — only runs in business_line caller-ID mode
Time Machine: act as the viewed rental's cron and fast-forward it N days
Fires isolated sandbox-* workers (never the real cron) on the prod test tenant behind a tenant-lock and blast-radius check; the dev-only /api/dev/sandbox route holds the prod key
Invalidate the rental page's query keys directly because Supabase Realtime depends on the supabase_realtime publication, which is empty outside prod
Hard-coded mirror of the rental detail page's 15 billing query keys — must be kept in sync with rentals/[id]/page.tsx
Belt-and-braces rental id detection from usePathname plus window.location, because either source alone has failed before
Visible 'v4' build marker and diagnostic block so a stale browser bundle is self-evident
Fixed-fixture controls hidden (fixturesVisible=false) because they led users to fast-forward the WRONG rental; code kept but unreachable
Date-only values parsed from their parts so a timezone never shifts the day
settledByPrepay explainer: charges accrued but were absorbed by the rental's prepaid balance, which is why Balance Due stays $0
/api/dev/sandbox — dev-only Next route that holds the prod key and dispatches sandbox actions
Shared empty-state pattern (icon, title, description, optional action)
Shared breadcrumb navigation trail with current-page emphasis
Table-cell truncation that reveals the full value in a click-toggled tooltip
Currency input: regex-guarded decimal text entry that emits number | undefined
Display string re-synced when the value changes externally (e.g. auto-calculated price)
Fine capture (PCN / speeding / other) against a customer and vehicle
Customer and vehicle auto-link each other through the active-rentals map
Fine evidence upload into the fine-evidence storage bucket with a fine_files row per file
Ledger entries for a fine are left to the database trigger, not written by the client
Security-deposit pre-authorisation hold placement (Stripe Checkout, hold only)
Email the hold link by reusing send-invoice-email with amount/description overrides
Stale-hold reconcile: hold_already_active opens an in-dialog 'Check with Stripe' instead of a dead end (the GMT case)
classifyVerify: only verified + no live hold + a conclusively dead status (expired/captured/failed) reopens placement
Fail closed on ambiguity: requires_action/processing and worker-owned rows must not reopen placement, because a second authorisation double-holds the renter's card
If the verify call itself fails, re-enable the buttons — create-hold-checkout runs its own liveness probe and refuses, so the worst case is a second refusal
Machine skip codes from create-hold-checkout translated to operator-readable English
Booking origin derived by rewriting the portal host (test.portal.localhost:3001 -> test.localhost:3000)
Portal payment collection hub — manual record, payment link, emailed link and saved-card charge in one dialog
Manual payment: insert payments row then allocate it through apply-payment

On apply-payment failure delete BOTH the ledger Payment row and the payments row — the FK is ON DELETE SET NULL, and an orphan ledger Payment gets drained by FIFO into phantom credit ($390.55 incident)
Duplicate-payment guard: same rental, same amount, last 14 days, not Cancelled (RevTek R-1ac41d double-recorded $390.55)
Refuse to record without a resolved rental_id — an unlinked payment either FIFOs onto the wrong rental or becomes an invisible Credit
Send payment link: create-checkout-session opened in a new tab; the Stripe webhook commits the payment
Email Stripe link: checkout session created first, then emailed via send-invoice-email with a matching overrideAmount
paygAccrualId stamped on Stripe Checkout metadata so the webhook can call payg_settle_invoice; the manual path settles through apply-payment instead
installmentId stamped on Stripe Checkout metadata for installment_settle_invoice; manual and saved-card paths settle via mark-installment-paid afterwards
onPaymentSuccess('recorded' | 'pending') contract — callers must never mark anything paid on 'pending', because only the webhook commits it
Off-session charge of the card on file — the only control here that moves money by itself
Idempotency key DERIVED from rental|amount|purpose via FNV-1a so it survives dialog reopen, remount and page reload
Key rotates only when a repeat is provably safe (Stripe refused) or explicitly wanted (operator confirmed duplicate, once per intent)
charged_but_not_recorded takeover panel: non-dismissible, carries the PaymentIntent id, never described as a failed charge
authentication_required (3-D Secure) is not a decline — the step converts into an 'email them a link' offer
Charge amount is strictly the operator-visible field with NO fallback chain — the confirmation is the last thing anyone sees before the money moves
Saved-card button hidden behind `false &&` on request; every mechanism behind it deliberately retained and re-enablable by flipping one condition
Client-side RBAC mirrors charge-saved-card's server gate: head_admin/admin, or a manager with editor on the payments tab
placeDepositHoldAfter rides on the payment so the webhook authorises the deposit off-session on the same card, with a per-guest operator opt-out
Customer-facing links resolve to NEXT_PUBLIC_BOOKING_BASE_URL or https://{slug}.{base domain}, never localhost — mirrors send-payg-reminders' deriveBookingOrigin
Synchronous useRef in-flight guards, because React loading state updates too late to stop a same-tick second click

Reason placeholder deliberately avoids damage examples — recovering damage from a card on file needs post-damage written consent (CA Civ. Code 1939.15(a), NY GBL 396-z(7)) and that mandate has not shipped
localStorage handoff (pending_email_payment_<rentalId>, payment_target_categories_<rentalId>) read by the rental detail page's polling fallback
Caller-supplied outstandingBalanceOverride wins over the dialog's own hooks, which under-count extension charges and invoice fill-ins
Rental cancellation with full / partial / no refund and a mandatory reason
A payment still in requires_capture is released, not refunded — the money was never captured
Pre-cancellation preview of Bonzah policies to cancel and unpaid Insurance ledger charges to write off (premium refund subject to Bonzah approval)
Capture the security-deposit pre-auth hold with a mandatory reason
Two-phase refresh-then-charge: a dead authorisation cannot be captured, so a fresh hold is placed first
Partial capture locked off until Stripe grants multicapture — otherwise the uncaptured remainder is released and the customer sees the hold vanish and reappear
Quote the rental's actual deposit_hold_expires_at instead of a flat 'about 7 days' — the real window depends on card and account (extended authorization reaches 30 days)
justRefreshed suppresses the stale expiry line, which otherwise renders a red 'this lapsed' warning under a green 'Hold refreshed' toast
A hold_expired code returned mid-capture flips the dialog back to the refresh phase
Customer insurance certificate upload (PDF only, 10MB) into customer-documents storage
Same filename for the same customer updates the existing document row instead of inserting, so a re-upload is not a duplicate
AI scan kicked off fire-and-forget — a scan failure must not fail the upload (ai_scan_status stays 'pending')
Printable / save-as-PDF customer rental invoice (react-to-print, A4)
Invoice line-item composition: rental fee, promo discount, extras, delivery, Bonzah insurance, tax, service fee, pre-authorisation
per_day extras expanded across the rental day count via the shared extraLineTotal helper
Tenant-branded invoice header (logo, app name, accent colour) with a hard-coded #C5A572 accent fallback
Invoice/rental dates rendered through parseLocalDate so date-only columns are not shifted a day by the browser timezone
Per-category refund (Tax, Service Fee, Pre-Authorization, Rental) through process-refund
Partial refund expressible as a fixed amount or a percentage of the maximum refundable
Fine refunds bypass process-refund and write the ledger entry client-side, because fine ledger rows may have no rental_id and the edge function filters on it
due_date offset by the count of existing Fine refunds to satisfy the ux_rental_charge_unique constraint (rental_id + due_date + type + category)
